Subject: Greg Lavecchia, CEO & Co-founder of Bloom Nutrition.
Context: Bootstrapped Bloom to $180M, doing ~$500M run rate now. Sold a ~30% stake to Nutrabolt/Keurig Dr Pepper for an aggressive retail expansion (beverage/energy drinks).
Modules Covered:

ORG (Organic and Content) & MCR (Paid Social Creative): Built a massive in-house influencer program. 15B+ views. Hiring scouts to use VPNs on TikTok to manipulate algorithms and find out-of-market macro/micro influencers. Giving influencers creative freedom with no strict briefs.

OFF (Offers) & CXP (Post-Purchase Experience): Initially sold PDF workout guides ($9.99) with free updates and Facebook group access. Moved into supplements because community asked. Used physical mixer freebies (Gift With Purchase) to get product placement in influencer videos.
WLD (Wild Bets): Huge in-real-life (IRL) events like a retro diner takeover in Austin with free food/drinks to generate digital content and test unreleased flavors. "Restock" as validity marketing.

MEA (Measurement and Economics) & ADC (Ad Copy and Deployment): Zero attribution on influencer campaigns. No affiliate codes. No UTMs. Optimizing for pure top-of-funnel reach. Reverse-engineering influencer payouts by taking Meta's CPM and cutting it in half (target <$2 CPMs). Omnichannel funneling: using digital traffic to force retail sell-through (Amazon -> Target -> 50k doors). Refusing to rely heavily on Meta ads.
FIN (Finance and Accounting): Selling 30% of the company to Nutrabolt to handle the capital-intensive beverage logistics and immediately triple the enterprise value of the remaining stake.

PRD (Product Research): Entering highly saturated markets (energy drinks) but finding white space in accessibility, flavor, and female demographics. Never reinvent the wheel (e.g., put energy drinks in a standard energy drink can).
Since 4+ modules (ORG, MCR, OFF, WLD, MEA, ADC, FIN, PRD) get real coverage, this is a 99-multi source.
